ValidationRule.description: Account must have sub industry at 30% BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", Probability >= 0.30, ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.Account_Sub_Industry__c)), OR( RecordType.Name = "Education", RecordType.Name = "Healthcare", RecordType.Name = "Travel", RecordType.Name = "B2B" ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: *** Go to Account Record and fill in 'Account Sub Industry' field. ***
